label: GO step when the agent picks a2, early/mid episode (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and only when the policy picks a2: choice logit < -4.4, model_act == 2, never on a1 choices. It essentially never fires after episode trial ~60 (nothing past trial 70), and it is strongest in trials 10-50. It never fires at D1 or D2, or when in_rew = 1 (a rewarded previous trial makes the GO input differ). The predicate GO & model_act==2 & ep_trial<60 covers about 99% of the activation mass but has only about 9% precision: it fires on only a small, episode-dependent subset of these steps (3726 of 6000 episodes; more often when S2 started good and after an unrewarded previous trial, prev_reward=0 lift 1.8x). Narrowing by mid-range value (7.7-8.1) or prev_reward==0 raises precision only to 0.14-0.18 and costs recall, and there is no clean trial-local rule. I used model_act (the agent own current output) instead of the FUTURE variable action, which scores identically.
